name: litecoinspace.org (mempool/Esplora API for Litecoin)
operator: litecoinspace.org (Litecoin community deployment of the mempool open-source project)
tier_rationale: Community deployment of the mempool open-source explorer for Litecoin with an identifiable project, public API documentation and terms (A8 community). Registry tiers: Blockstream, Blockchain.com, BlockCypher and Blockchair trusted; mempool.space and litecoinspace community.

reliability.justification: Esplora-compatible reader of the public Litecoin ledger: balances and transactions are chain facts.

esplora_api.title: litecoinspace.org Esplora-compatible REST API (LTC address stats, address txs, chain tip)

terms.quote: Per-adapter terms recorded: Esplora, mempool, litecoinspace and Blockchain.com 'open'; BlockCypher and Blockchair 'key-terms'.

esplora_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P211 cond 6). Research C0486 (verified_live 200; prep live check 2026-11-26: Cloudflare-fronted mempool-electrs, LTC /api/address/{a} and /txs follow the Esplora schema, tip 3219589). Never call /api/v1/... paths here (404). Used by btc_explorers (LTC, first public adapter).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G09-2 (P211). Undocumented public limits: 1 s politeness, crypto ttl 1 h, 5 s timeout (15 s explorer budget).
